in_marathi.name: Satyawan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satyawan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Satyawan is a Sanskrit name that means truthful and honest. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Satya' which means truth. This name is ideal for a child whose parents value honesty and truthfulness above all else.
